applies_to: learned candidates; classical baselines are reference only

replaced_by.name: partial_recall_0p1
replaced_by.definition: fraction of GT pixels with 1/255 < alpha < 254/255 predicted within +/-0.1

gate_revision.reason: a binary mask has ~0 partial alpha, so the 5x ratio is undefined (division by near-zero). Replaced by an absolute recall condition on the soft-edge fixtures.

replaced_by.name: composite_mean_delta_vs_grabcut_rect_codes
replaced_by.definition: band composite error per background (gray/green/white); candidate band mean may be at most +1.0 code vs grabcut_rect and band max at most 1.25x

gate_revision.reason: no absolute composite value had a measured basis; upstream alpha error dominates, so the realistic contract is 'no worse than the binary baseline' per background.

gate_revision.note: grabcut_rect is a binary baseline, so part of any SAD gain is the binary/soft difference itself, not matte accuracy. Report both SAD and band MAE before claiming a win.

summary.note: gate verdicts are mechanical; a pass still requires human visual review of fabricated detail and does not approve a product feature
